about: Written by `python3 tools/vc6.py --all`. One row per function compiled from src/. verdict: MATCH = every byte and every relocation agree with SheepD3D.exe; MATCH~ = every byte agrees but some target address was only readable from the exe (listed in unresolved: CRT helpers, or a name the symbol tables spell differently); DIFF = compiled but not yet equal; NOADDR = a compiler-generated helper nothing refers to (no address, not a game function to count).
